policy: One packet per physical performance; five localized events per issue type across at least two sources; reviewer unexposed to predictions; separate checksum-bound audit. No tuning on this intake.
interpretation: Localized audible issue events, not per-note transcription truth. Same-kind predicted note findings within 150 ms are clustered. Only explicitly reviewed coverage is used for precision. Noise/uncertain labels are unscored. No automatic quality approval or threshold changes.
